title: CBW Claim, Evidence and Freshness Model V1
description: Canonical claim/evidence graph and freshness governance for the continuous market-intelligence platform. Architecture model only; example ids and the example.invalid domain are placeholders, not live sources.

fields.predicate: one of [REGULATORY_STATUS, LICENSE, RESTRICTION, REGISTRATION, KYC, PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY, PAYMENT_RAIL, FEE, LIMIT, SECURITY, HISTORY, AFFILIATE_OFFER]
fields.statementText: concise factual statement, not marketing prose
fields.limitations: string describing scope/uncertainty, required for LOW or UNVERIFIED
fields.isCritical: boolean; regulatory, security, sanction, restriction claims are critical

invariants: a claim with confidence LOW or UNVERIFIED MUST record limitations
a claim with no non-contradicted supporting evidence MUST NOT hold confidence above LOW
a critical claim in freshnessState STALE or EXPIRED MUST trigger publication suppression per the publication binding model

fields.sourceType: one of [OFFICIAL_SITE, HELP_CENTER, REGULATOR_REGISTER, RSS, API, NEWS, COMMUNITY]

fields.storageObjectKey: object-store key in the evidence bucket, not committed to Git
fields.redirectChainRef: optional RedirectObservation id in the affiliate model

invariants: snapshots are immutable and content-addressed by contentHash
snapshot bytes live in object storage, never in the operational database or Git
a SUPERSEDES edge requires a target ClaimVersion and creates a supersession record
an OPEN conflict on a critical claim MUST hold publication in AMBER or RED lane
versions are append-only; superseded versions are retained, never deleted

fields.agent: agent id from the agent roles standard

criticalClaimStaleBehavior: When a critical claim reaches STALE it MUST downgrade to at most confidence LOW and schedule an immediate recheck; when it reaches EXPIRED its publication bindings MUST be suppressed until re-verified.
